title: Louis Vuitton Noé
subtitle: Toledo Blue Epi leather, made in France, January 1989
details: Epi leather in Toledo Blue, smooth leather trim

examined.title: Date code
examined.text: “8901 A2” is heat-embossed on the side strap tab. This is the late-1980s format: year 89, month 01, followed by the French factory code A2. The date fits the Epi line, introduced in 1985, and the Toledo Blue colour, produced 1985–2002.

examined.title: Embossing and stamps
examined.text: The Epi grain is even and continuous across the panels. The embossed LV logo on the side is crisp and correctly proportioned, and the grommets are engraved “LOUIS VUITTON”.

examined.title: Stitching
examined.text: Straight, evenly spaced stitching in dark thread along the trim, base and strap, with a consistent stitch length and no loose or doubled stitches.

examined.title: Hardware
examined.text: Solid brass D-rings, buckle and grommets with patina consistent with age. The interior zip pocket has an LV-stamped pull.

examined.title: Interior
examined.text: Alcantara-type microfibre lining with an Epi-trimmed zip pocket, as on Noé bags of this period.

examined.title: Construction
examined.text: Shape, proportions, base piping and drawstring routing are consistent with the model.

condition: Colour loss and light whitening along the top edge and on the drawstring.
Scuffs and colour loss on the base corners and the lower piping.
Darkening and wear on the shoulder strap.
Tarnish and patina on the brass hardware.
Light marks on the interior base.
No tears or open seams observed.
